title: Stop borrowing greatness from the world
summary: This meets the reflex to stand near power and hope it will steady you. The line says the world's important people cannot save you; humble company can.
takeaway: Seek the humble, not the impressive.
lifeApplication: Before chasing the loudest room or biggest name, ask who actually leaves your heart cleaner. Walk toward the quieter servant instead.

source.shortMeaning: Worldly stature cannot save; humble company can lift the heart quickly.
source.lifeApplication: When status pulls you, choose the company that deepens remembrance instead.
